_comment: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fairy_ring - kräver The Restless Ghost, Priest in Peril, Nature Spirit, Lost City,
Fairytale I - Growing Pains och 'Partially completed Fairytale II - Cure a Queen (up until you're "granted permission"
to use them)'. Dramen eller lunar staff behövs, utom med elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary.
Fairytale I tar med de andra fyra quests via kedjan; Fairytale II-steget är ett manuellt mål eftersom bara en del krävs.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ardougne_cloak - cloak 1-4 för easy/medium/hard/elite Ardougne Diary, hämtas gratis
hos Two-pints i Flying Horse Inn. Item-id: 13121-13124 (gameval ARDY_CAPE_EASY/MEDIUM/HARD/ELITE), med varianter som diary-rewards-templaten, så att de kopplas ihop. Dramen staff: 772.
Fairytale I och II lades till i quest-requirements.json samma dag.
name: Ardougne cloak and fairy rings
description: Fairy ring access and Ardougne cloaks 1-4 through the Ardougne Diary

children.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen: get permission to use fairy rings
children.note: Start the quest and continue until the Fairy Godfather grants permission. The rest of the quest and its skill requirements are not needed.
Wield a dramen or lunar staff to use the rings. Not needed after the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary.
Free from Two-pints in the Flying Horse Inn.
Free from Two-pints. Unlimited teleports to the Ardougne farming patch.
